name: Valuable Vantages
summary: Around Hillsbrad Foothills, Deathstalker Masoj needs you to restore three signaling marks. Bat riders use those points to guide strategic troops to their drop-off sites.

sections.title: Three Peaks
sections.body: You carry Apothecary Vials to three high places: the hills beside Dun Garok, the plateau above Dunholde Keep, and the Headland ridge above Hillsbrad. Their vapors draw bats back to the marks. Then Masoj's high command can guide its troops through the foothills.

sections.title: Masoj's Orders
sections.body: Masoj asks you to search for crushed, empty vials and renew the marks at all three places. He says this work serves plans advancing under the Deathstalkers' banner.

faq.q: Who is asking me to place the vials?
faq.answer: Deathstalker Masoj asks you to restore the signaling marks around Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why are the signaling marks needed?
faq.answer: Bat riders use the signaling points to guide strategic troops to drop-off sites.

faq.q: Where do I place the vials?
faq.answer: Place the vials on the hills beside Dun Garok, the plateau above Dunholde Keep, and the Headland ridge above Hillsbrad.

faq.q: What do the vial vapors do?
faq.answer: The vapors draw bats back to the desired drop-off points.
